rovercub.note: the pale ground ellipse under the feet and between the legs, off the built front

locus.note: the new front turned: a round grey critter from behind, its tail curled up beside it in a loop. 5012 the same with a fluffier tail; 5002 shows the loop best but is a black-eared cat in profile; 5001/5004 came framed.

relay.note: the built back's draft cropped to its subject and scaled so it stands 58 cells tall (was 42), feet on the ground line; the plain zoom, not re-gridded -- the i2i passes (5021 at 0.3, 5022 at 0.4) tinted it blue and the reduction kept the tint as violet fringes.
